feeds.title: Great Lakes Commercial Finance Blog
feeds.description: GLCF is a Certified Development Company that partners with lenders to help small business owners finance fixed assets through the 504 Loan Program. The main benefits of the 504 Loan Program are a low down payment and low fixed interest rates for up to 25 years. GLCF was founded in 1981 and has over 35 years of experience to guide you through each step of the 504 Loan Program. Their expert staff has many years of experience and knows how to streamline the process for both small businesses needing financing and lending institutions seeking to minimize loan risk.
